tooltip.nusmp.astral_edge.lore: Forged from the metal of fallen stars; it remembers the shape of the sky.
tooltip.nusmp.astral_edge.primary: Right-click: Starfall Cut. A crescent of starlight 16 blocks long: foes it cuts are lit up and slowed.
tooltip.nusmp.astral_edge.alt: Sneak + right-click: Constellation. Marks up to five foes within 14 blocks with stars, then strikes each in turn along a line of light.
tooltip.nusmp.void_edge.lore: It cuts the space it passes through. Something looks back from its cracks.
tooltip.nusmp.void_edge.primary: Right-click: Rift Cut. Tears a rift 10 blocks ahead that drags foes in and cuts them twice, blinding and slowing them.
tooltip.nusmp.void_edge.alt: Sneak + right-click: Void Step. Steps through the void up to 9 blocks, cutting everything in the way.
tooltip.nusmp.fenrir_sword.lore: Named for the wolf that swallowed the sun. Its wolves are still hungry.
tooltip.nusmp.fenrir_sword.primary: Right-click: Fang Rush. Lunges up to 8 blocks like a wolf, biting everything in the way; the bite festers.
tooltip.nusmp.fenrir_sword.alt: Sneak + right-click: Fenrir's Howl. A howl 8 blocks wide: foes are thrown back, weakened and slowed; you and your allies run faster and hit harder.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_renewed.lore: An old rune-blade, mended. One rune still answers.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_renewed.primar: Right-click: Rune Burst. The runes flare in a burst 3.5 blocks wide; every slotted rune adds to its strength.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_renewed.alt: Sneak + right-click: Rune Ward. The runes close round you: Absorption and Resistance, shared with allies near you.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_ancient.lore: A rune-blade from before the first kingdoms. Two runes answer.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_ancient.primar: Right-click: Rune Burst. The ancient runes flare in a burst 4.5 blocks wide; every slotted rune adds to its strength.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_ancient.alt: Sneak + right-click: Rune Ward. The runes close round you: Absorption, Resistance and Regeneration, shared with allies near you.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_mythical.lore: The legend the rune-smiths wrote about themselves. Three runes answer.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_mythical.prima: Right-click: Rune Burst. The mythical runes flare in a burst 6 blocks wide; every slotted rune adds to its strength.
tooltip.nusmp.runic_sword_mythical.alt: Sneak + right-click: Rune Ward. The runes close round you: Absorption, Resistance II and Regeneration II, shared with allies near you.
tooltip.nusmp.elite_weapon.swing: A full-strength swing adds its bonus strike.
tooltip.nusmp.runic.how: Drag an engraving book or a rune onto the sword with the right mouse button.
message.nusmp.runic.full: All %s rune slots are in use.
tooltip.nusmp.nightingale.lullaby: Sneaking: the Lullaby heals you and your allies nearby
tooltip.nusmp.catalyst.line1: Raises you for good: %s Skill Points and +%s maximum health.
tooltip.nusmp.catalyst.line2: At most %s can be used by one person.
tooltip.nusmp.catalyst.use: Right-click to use it. It is used up.
message.nusmp.catalyst.spent: You can hold no more potential: %s of %s catalysts used.
message.nusmp.catalyst.used: Your potential opens: %s of %s catalysts used.
message.nusmp.chronicle.blank: The pages are blank. No chronicle is written here yet.
message.nusmp.chronicle.bound: A chronicle is bound to this book: %s. Its pages will open in a later season.
tooltip.nusmp.chronicle.note: It opens nothing yet; it only remembers which chronicle it belongs to.
tooltip.nusmp.walpurgis_orb: A crystal of the Walpurgis council.
tooltip.nusmp.walpurgis_seal: The seal of the Walpurgis council.
tooltip.nusmp.crate_key: Opens one %s Crate. Use it on the crate.
message.nusmp.crate.locked: This crate is locked. It needs a %s.
message.nusmp.crate.sealed: The crates are sealed on this server.
